results.name: Flood in Saarland region, Germany
results.reason:
On 17 May 2024 at 08:00 a flood event was reported affecting Saarland region in Germany. 
The event is ongoing and damages has been reported in the affected urban areas. 
Copernicus EMS Rapid Mapping has been requested to provide initial rough estimate, flood extent and damage assessment.
